notes.title: Co-op campaign released!
notes.content:
Hi, Spacelanders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/2034468bf8ad137caf3fba204251314127c563c6.png[/img]

We are ready to release co-op campaign for you.

[list]
[*]Six new co-op story battles you can play through with your friends
[*]Two additional heroes, Harvey and Theo, will help Jim and Barret take down a gang of smugglers
[*]Several new types of enemies have plenty of unexpected tactical surprises for you
[*]The impressive space map will expand the world of Spaceland for you and help you learn more about the Star Federation
[*]And, needless to say, at the end of the storyline campaign you can expect a challenging boss with a couple of aces up its sleeve
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/13ceb8b57be83f3309a20adfad35e465b9445730.jpg[/img]

And we have make 3 different difficulty modes. So feel free to play in main campagin or online co-op dlc with your own pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/742542037149d6ff11aeae9cfafd80689bb187c1.png[/img]

Feel free to share with us how new co-op campaign is.

New co-op campagin is free so you could add it to your spaceland game right now without any doubts. Have a nice play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162220/Spaceland_Cooperative/

notes.title: New daily missions!
notes.content:
Greetings, Spacelanders! 

Brand new update. New daily missions have appeared at the Mercenaries Guild base:
[list]
[*]  Hydroelectric Power Station. Shut down energy production in the laboratory by disabling the four computers that control the generators.
[*]  Mantrap. Our team got surrounded during a cleanup operation. Defeat all enemies.
[*]  Bridges. Mutagens are being produced secretly in this laboratory. Shut down the pumps by disabling the control console.
[*]  Deep Freeze. A squad of soldiers is trapped. The only way out is through a freezer chamber infested with monsters.
[/list]

We’ve also added lots of other improvements and fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/9bbbf7d97bd21973cba2c60c5e13633e4ffab6bc.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #8 - Online Co-Op
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/005630e2c794ce87fdd2b93ac846d64ce39b94ab.png[/img]

Hi Spacelanders.


Good news everyone! We have finished all three online modes:
[list]
[*] Online Duel - Monsters vs Soldiers
[*] Online Duel - Soldiers vs Soldiers
[*] And last but not least - Online Co-Op
[/list]

We now have full support for all of the online modes. We have made more than we promised on launch of our game because many of our players wanted to play Online Co-Op. So hope you like it.

And here are other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug with daily mission "Survive it". You can get medals for speedy completion of this mission
[*] Steam Chat button is renamed to Community button and leads to our Steam community hub. Because not all players accessed to the chat correctly.
[*] PvP freezes fixed
[*] Zone of click on character portraits is expanded. Thanks to our player Adobe that mentioned this issue
[*] Other minor improvements
[/list]

Thanks for playing and stay tuned. We are working hard to make Spaceland better and still determined to fulfill our post-release plan. Hope you appreciate it.

Have a nice day.

tags.feature: And last but not least - Online Co-Op

notes.title: Update #7 - Daily Missions Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/d27795b284a57e68536caf37afe1911f0c75f0bf.png[/img]

Hi, Spacelanders.

We have reworked our Extra Missions into Daily Missions Mode.
[list]
[*] You get reputation for completing the daily mission
[*] You get chips in daily mission that you can use in main scenario to upgrade your heroes. If you want to upgrade more soldiers - you could use daily missions for it
[/list]

Hope it will make completion of Daily Missions more interesting. More of that we have fixed some bugs and issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/45e403e96e567a6b90bfc1996a9876d350b989cb.png[/img]

We wish you a merry cristmas and happy new year. Some new updates will appear in 2020 too.

Best regards,
Tortuga Team.

notes.title: Multiplayer added!
notes.content:
Hi Spacelanders,

Multiplayer has been added in this update! As we promised in Autumn 2019. ;)
[list]
[*] It's an Beta version of Multiplayer mode. Expect some bugs
[*] Only one map available - Soldiers VS Monsters
[*] You can create your room for Online Duel or join one of the existed
[*] Ask your friends to create multiplayer rooms in Spaceland to ease matchmaking process
[*] You could use Steam Chat of Spaceland Community to ask some Spaceland players to join your Duel Room
[*] We have plans to add some more multiplayer content. Soldiers VS Soldiers mode is in our plans
[*] Please, report any issues at spaceland@tortugateam.com or on Steam forum
[/list]

Best regars,
Tortuga Team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021070/Spaceland/

notes.title: First improvements
notes.content:
Greetings!

Fresh off the heels of a great launch (once again, we'd like to thank each and every one of you so much!), we're releasing an update to the game, solving some of the issues we've discovered.

[list]
[*] German translation is proofread and improved one more time. And doublechecked by our player Alex [GER]. Many thanks to him.
[*] English texts for achievements improved
[*] Bug with boss and frozen mine fixed
[*] Redback shooters AI fixed. They attack you even when you are near them
[*] Carmine achievement fixed. Play mission 3, if you want to get it 
[*] TAB crash when you had dead heroes is fixed.
[*] Language detection from Steam Client has been fixed
[*] You can cancel selected ability with right click
[*] Visuals of geyser are hidden proprely now
[*] Right click stops opening settings in battle
[*] +200% money for replaying (!) the mission with all achievements completed
[*] Bug with missing shield of Markus fixed
[*] Prices for equipment in chapters 2 and 3 lowered
[/list]

Critical bug with infninte waiting is still pending fix.

We hope that you enjoy the game! Don't forget to leave any feedback, ideas or just thoughts about Spaceland in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1021070/discussions/]official Steam Discussion forums[/url]!
